title: A hearing-loss study's own legend
summary: A study's Questionnaire adds its own condition list, which fills the symbols and gets its own legend, beside disorders.
shows: A family in a hearing-loss study, drawn with the study's own form. Its Questionnaire is open-pedigree's built-in form plus a Hearing study tab. On that tab, Hearing loss is a custom legend: its terms come from a SNOMED CT value set (hearing loss and every kind of it), they fill the symbols as disorders do, and they get a legend of their own. Lily and Ben have congenital sensorineural hearing loss; their grandmother Edith had late-onset sensorineural hearing loss, and their cousin Sam conductive hearing loss, so the legend shows three conditions.
The tab's other items show how a form can follow the answers: Age at onset appears only once a hearing loss is chosen, and Audiogram on file only for people enrolled in the study.
hard: The study's conditions are separate from the pedigree's disorders: they have their own legend and colours, can be switched to black-and-white patterns with the rest, and travel in the GA4GH FHIR export as Conditions, so another FHIR system sees them as conditions too, not as free text.

questionnaire.what: A custom legend (mapsToLegendCondition): a repeating choice over a SNOMED CT value set, expanded by the terminology server. Each person's choices fill their symbol and are listed in the Hearing loss legend.
Shown only when Hearing loss has an answer (enableWhen with the exists operator).
Shown only for people enrolled in the study (enableWhen on another item's answer).
